t: 穆罕默德和他的追随者征服了这座城市,而克赖什氏族协会投降.
te: Muhammad and his followers conquer the city, and the Quraysh association of clans surrenders.
dz: 征服麦加:穆罕默德和他的追随者征服了这座城市,而克赖什氏族协会投降.
de: Conquest of Mecca: Muhammad and his followers conquer the city, and the Quraysh association of clans surrenders.

t: 希拉克略皇帝将基督教最神圣的文物之一——真正的十字架归还给耶路撒冷。
te: Emperor Heraclius returns the True Cross, one of the holiest Christian relics, to Jerusalem.
dz: 希拉克略皇帝将基督教最神圣的文物之一——真正的十字架归还给耶路撒冷。
de: Emperor Heraclius returns the True Cross, one of the holiest Christian relics, to Jerusalem.
